Official announcement (publishedAt 2026-10-06T17:32:00.000Z); Meta and Sierra co-developed Personal Agent Protocol with Genesys, Instinct, NiCE, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart. Stated v0.1 spec planned later in Oct 2026 and payment extensions are future directions ('could let').

Official announcement (publishedAt 2026-10-09T19:56:06.371Z); publishes draft Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) at personalagentprotocol.org (/.well-known/poppy.json) and announces 35 additional design partners including Visa, Mastercard, Adyen, PayPal, Venmo, Plaid, OpenAI, Cloudflare, Okta, 1Password, and Target. Explicitly positions Poppy as complementary to UCP.

Draft v0.1 specification; public GitHub repository personal-agent-protocol/personal-agent-protocol created on 2026-10-14 (initial commit e259d57 at 12:58:23Z, head f766ef8 at 15:35:49Z). Defines /.well-known/poppy.json discovery, mutual OAuth poppy_domains check, DPoP session tokens, resource-bound Bearer tokens for MCP (2025-06-18+), poppy:read/poppy:write scopes, and Conversations/Direct Conversations. Payments and push notifications remain open topics in /docs/path-to-1.

Draft v1 operations extension for Poppy v0.1. Defines two-phase proposed/confirm/in_progress/succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired state machine with immutable revision numbers, approved_by ('user' vs 'permission'), conversation-message non-confirmation rule, and at-most-once execution keyed by operation_id.

Official Summit 2026 recap (publishedAt 2026-10-06T18:01:51.141Z); documents Constellation of models (Linnaeus, Darwin, Curie, Fleming), Tandem Voice (Conversation vs Reasoning layers), Horizon long-running workflows, Ghostwriter, and Sierra one-click app in the Stripe App Marketplace.

Official announcement (publishedAt 2026-10-08T17:32:00.000Z); introduces fleming-1 real-time voice caller-agent detection model ('Information, not judgement') as a voice-channel complement to Personal Agent Protocol self-identification.

Official technical blog (publishedAt 2026-08-13T16:51:46.690Z); defines four runtime layers (Content, Rules & Policies, Supervisors, Deterministic Guards) plus offline Simulations, Red-teaming, and Agent Monitors.

Official engineering blog (publishedAt 2026-07-22T14:00:00.000Z); documents centralized MCP Gateway enforcing tool visibility gating ('an agent can't misuse what it never sees'), single-customer session isolation, and human-identity vs pre-authorized service-account workflow separation.

Official announcement (publishedAt 2026-04-07T19:35:00.000Z); Sierra verified as Level 1 PCI-compliant service provider on the Visa Global Service Provider Registry. Switches chat/voice payment collection out of the LLM loop into a predetermined server-validated PCI flow so raw Cardholder Data never enters LLM context.

Official Sierra Research tau2-bench (now tau3-bench) repository. Evaluation docs confirm default reward_basis=['DB','COMMUNICATE'] via gold-trajectory DB state hash rather than single-path action matching.
